% PGF calendar manual: all four day-list directions plus a compact month list.
\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{calendar}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\scriptsize]
  \calendar at (0,0)
    [dates=2000-01-30 to 2000-02-02,
     day list downward, day yshift=5mm, month yshift=7mm,
     day text=\%m0/\%d0];
  \calendar at (3.2,0)
    [dates=2000-01-30 to 2000-02-02,
     day list upward, day yshift=5mm, month yshift=7mm,
     day text=\%m0/\%d0];
  \calendar at (6.4,0)
    [dates=2000-01-30 to 2000-02-02,
     day list right, day xshift=5mm, month xshift=7mm,
     day text=\%m0/\%d0];
  \calendar at (6.4,-1.1)
    [dates=2000-01-30 to 2000-02-02,
     day list left, day xshift=5mm, month xshift=7mm,
     day text=\%m0/\%d0];

  \calendar at (0,-4.3)
    [dates=2000-01-01 to 2000-02-05,
     month list, month label left,
     day xshift=3mm, month yshift=7mm,
     every day/.style={draw, minimum size=3.3mm}]
    if (Sunday) [red];
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
